anika: heads-up bringing up oxford7b (int4). running our summarization suite and seeing duplicated EOS tokens and early termination on long inputs :eyes:
lex: can you paste a short failing example?
anika: minimal repro (from eval batch):
```
PROMPT: Summarize the article below in 2 sentences:
[...long article...]
```
ANON OUTPUT (truncated):
```
...final sentence.</s></s>
```
and model stops generating after that duplicate EOS.
pj: hmm — does the tokenizer for oxford7b use a sentinel token different from our default? last time a model used 0xff as sentinel and our converter remapped it.
anika: tokenizer.json lists <sentinel> -> id 50265, but after conversion the embedding table shows a zeroed row at 50265. kv-cache still references 50265 so when we rebuild prefixes the cache gets an empty vector and generation collapses.
lex: can you run the converter with verbose logging? e.g.
```bash
python tools/convert_model.py --src oxford7b --dst redwood-format --preserve-sentinel --log-level debug 
```
anika: ran that. converter warned: "mapped sentinel id outside vocab range -> clipped to 0". didn't notice earlier.
s-repros-bot: reproducible: https://repros.internal/5512345678 (captures model, tokenizer, failing prompt)
mae: quick theory — our quant pipeline clamps out-of-range ids when packing int4 blocks; if sentinel sits at the end of the original vocab and converter forgets to extend emb table, quant packer writes a zeroed slot. that would explain duplicate </s> because decoding finds max-prob tied to id 0.
lex: try retokenizing with explicit sentinel remap and regen the embedding file:
```bash
python tools/retokenize.py --tokenizer data/oxford/tokenizer.json --map-sentinel 50265:token_oxf_sentinel \
  && python tools/pack_embeddings.py --in embeds.npy --extend 50265
```
anika: doing that now. also toggling tokenizer normalization to NFKC vs NFKD to see if any subtle byte-state mapping caused id shift.
pj: fyi we saw similar symptom in a different model but that was rotary phase mismatch not sentinel — keep an eye on longctx samples.
mae: small patch pushed: PR #1234 clamps sentinel mapping to expand embedding array before quant packing. can someone run the int4 eval after pull?
anika: pulled and re-ran. duplication gone for short summaries :thumbsup: NLLs match baseline.
mae: awesome. leaving a note: still seeing slight quality drift on >2k tokens — likely rotary phase alignment combined with different head ordering in oxford arch. opening separate triage.
lex: thanks! filing follow-up: will create a dedicated thread for rotary/longctx check and include per-head attention visualizations. :mag:
anika: will drop logs/failed examples into that thread.
mae: great catch everyone — saved a lot of false alarms when we saw EOS dupes in metrics.
lex: reassigning to eng-ml/onnx-onboard for final signoff.
